First release of the **warthurton fork** of ExplorerTabPlus. Versions are `Major.Minor.Build.Patch`: the first three numbers follow ExplorerTabPlus (2.6.0), the last number is this fork's patch level.

## Added

- **Command-line opening** — `ExplorerTabUtility.exe "C:\path" ["D:\other"]` forwards the locations to the running instance and opens each as a tab; an already-open location is activated instead of duplicated. (from [MeverikC/ExplorerTabUtility](https://github.com/MeverikC/ExplorerTabUtility))

## Fixed / improved

- Lower idle CPU from less process scanning. (from [MeverikC/ExplorerTabUtility](https://github.com/MeverikC/ExplorerTabUtility))
- Tab reuse now excludes only the window being converted instead of using a 2-second grace period, avoiding duplicate tabs on rapid consecutive opens. (from [MeverikC/ExplorerTabUtility](https://github.com/MeverikC/ExplorerTabUtility))

## Changed (fork maintenance)

- Title bar shows the version and "warthurton fork".
- About page: sponsor/donation links removed; maintainer card points to this fork; credits list links every fork and contributor whose work is included.
- The in-app updater, project links and installer URLs point to this repository.

## Which file should I download?

- **Not sure?** Use `ExplorerTabUtility_v2.6.0.1_Setup.exe`.
- **Portable zip:** `..._Net9.0_FrameworkDependent.zip` needs the [.NET 9 Desktop Runtime](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/9.0); `..._NetFW4.8.1.zip` works out of the box on Windows 11. Pick `x64` for most PCs, `arm64` for Windows on ARM, `x86` only for 32-bit Windows.
